requirements.text: The software shall detect and identify faults in chiller and cooling tower subsystems based on sensed and fixed data.
The software shall provide a visual indication of faults, descriptive information concerning the faults and their causes, and suggested corrective actions.
The software shall store diagnostic results, sensed data, and fixed data to permanent storage for subsequent retrieval and analysis.
The software shall allow administrators to configure diagnostic parameters, including sensitivity levels and fixed data such as set points and equipment specifications.
The software shall support user authentication to distinguish between general users and administrators, with only administrators permitted to modify system settings or start/stop diagnostics.
The software shall provide a user interface to browse current and historical diagnostic results.
The software shall support input of sensed data from real-time data acquisition devices or from ASCII text files in a specified format.
The software shall validate sensed data against expected ranges and mark data as 'in doubt' or 'missing' if acquisition fails or values are out of range.
The software shall process sensed data and generate diagnostic results without requiring human expert intervention or manual data visualization.
The software shall provide a simple, graphical and textual format for displaying diagnostic results.
The software shall provide a 15-minute inactivity timeout for authenticated administrator sessions, reverting privileges to those of a general user.
The software architecture shall support the future incorporation of diagnostic algorithms for additional HVAC subsystems beyond chillers and cooling towers.
The software shall log all errors associated with obtaining, validating, converting, or storing sensed data.
The software shall be restricted to Microsoft Windows-compatible operating systems.
The software shall allow users to print screen images of diagnostic results and historical data upon request.
